name: Marebito ~Soshite Sekai wa Iro o Ushinau~
original_name: マレビト～そして世界は色を失う～
source:
1980s. Main character Kensuke lives a normal school life and prepares for a cultural festival. However, one day he starts to see a mysterious man hiding from him, and that changes his peaceful life. He remembers tales of Marebito which is either a production of unshaped human fantasies or a demon. Will Kensuke get it all from his youth or get trapped in a strange incident?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
20世纪80年代。主人公健介过着普通的校园生活，并为文化祭作准备。然而某天，他开始看见一个躲着自己的神秘男子，平静生活也随之改变。他想起了关于“稀人”的传说——那可能是无形人类幻想的产物，也可能是恶魔。健介能否尽情享受自己的青春，还是会陷入离奇事件？

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
